national_news.title: Parliament passes Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026
bullets: The Lok Sabha had earlier passed the Bill, which was then sent to the Rajya Sabha for discussion.
The Rajya Sabha can only make recommendations on the provisions of a Money Bill and return it to the Lok Sabha.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman replied to the discussion on the Bill in the Rajya Sabha.

national_news.title: Government notifies 11 more International Ports for e-visa holders
bullets: 11 more International Ports have been notified for e-visa holders to enter India.
The notification includes 9 land ports and 2 airports, including Bhopal and Tirupati airports.
India processes approximately 95 per cent of e-visa applications in less than 72 hours.

national_news.title: Jharkhand Student Leader Devendra Nath Mahto Hospitalised After Police Lathi-Charge
bullets: Devendra Nath Mahto, a student protest leader, has been hospitalised due to a drastic drop in his blood sugar level.
Mahto has been on a hunger strike for 9 days over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations in Jharkhand.
The BJP has called for a Jharkhand bandh to protest against 'police atrocities' and Mahto's alleged injury during the lathi-charge.

national_news.title: 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes western Colombia, death toll rises to 132
bullets: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, resulting in 132 deaths and over 570 injuries.
The epicentre of the earthquake was near San Jose del Palmar in the Choco region, about 400 km west of Bogota.
Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella declared an emergency to speed up rescue efforts.

national_news.title: India wins 17 medals, including 4 gold, on opening day of U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won 17 medals, including 4 gold, on the opening day of the U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
Indian fencers secured 4 gold, 4 silver, and 9 bronze medals across 6 individual events.
Nikhil Wagh won the gold medal in the men's Sabre event, while Lakshay Badser secured silver.

national_news.title: Nation pays homage to revolutionary freedom fighter Khudiram Bose on 119th martyrdom day
bullets: Khudiram Bose was the first among the Indian revolutionaries in Bengal to be executed by the British in 1908.
He joined India's freedom movement at a very young age and became one of the youngest martyrs of the anti-British struggle.
Various programmes have been organised across the country to remember the young revolutionary and pay tribute to his supreme sacrifice.

national_news.title: Indian Navy-US Navy EOD Exercise 2026 commences at Southern Naval Command
bullets: The exercise aims to enhance interoperability and strengthen professional cooperation between the specialist diving and EOD teams of the two navies.
The 5-day exercise will comprise Subject Matter Expert Exchanges, cross-training, equipment demonstrations, and scenario-based practical exercises.
The programme will facilitate the exchange of contemporary EOD methodologies, emerging technologies, and best practices.

national_news.title: US to make online applications mandatory for several immigration benefits
bullets: The US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will make online applications mandatory for several immigration benefits.
The move aims to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
Forms available for electronic filing for at least 180 days will be required to be submitted online.

national_news.title: US Federal Court Dismisses Fraud and Bribery Case Against Gautam Adani
bullets: A US federal court dismissed criminal charges against Indian businessman Gautam Adani in an alleged fraud and bribery case.
The judge expressed concern over the Justice Department's decision to abandon the prosecution.
The judge sought clarification on the reasons for dropping the charges, including whether Adani's investment pledge in the US influenced the decision.

national_news.title: India and Israel Discuss Ways to Deepen Development Partnership
bullets: India and Israel discussed cooperation in Centres of Excellence in agriculture, capacity building in agriculture and water management.
The two sides also exchanged views on further strengthening the India-Israel development partnership.
MASHAV, Israel's Agency for International Development Cooperation, was established to share Israel's expertise with other countries.

national_news.title: Hockey World Cup to be played in new format; quarterfinal stage scrapped
bullets: The FIH Hockey Men's and Women's World Cup 2026 will feature a revamped competition structure.
The traditional quarterfinal stage has been scrapped, and the top two teams from each of the two crossover pools will advance directly to the semi-finals.
The tournament will be jointly hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands from August 15 to 30.

national_news.title: India secures two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in the men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in the men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
This achievement marks the first time Indians have won medals in the high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: Piyush Goyal highlights GeM's role in transparent public procurement
bullets: GeM ensures procurement of the right product of the right quality, at the right price and at the right time.
It promotes transparency, competitiveness, and good governance in public procurement.
GeM has replaced non-transparent and misused public procurement practices prior to its introduction.

national_news.title: Government Schemes for Indian Citizens
bullets: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is involved in designing various schemes.
These schemes aim to enhance social welfare, economic development, health, and education.
Eligibility, application processes, and benefits of each scheme are available for citizens.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Transfers Rs 1,100 to 1.13 Crore Social Security Pensioners
bullets: Bihar CM transfers Rs 1,100 to 1.13 crore social security pensioners
This move aims to support the economically vulnerable section of society
The total amount transferred is approximately Rs 1,233 crores

bihar_news.title: Empanelled Media Agency for Bihar Vidhan Mandal Joint Sessions
bullets: The Honourable Governor of Bihar gave speeches during joint sessions of Bihar Vidhan Mandal from 2023 to 2026.
Bihar is an entirely land–locked state located in the eastern part of the country.
The state has an outlet to the sea, although the exact details are not mentioned in the content.
